result.question: What did Athaliah see before she tore her clothes?

readings.answer: the king standing by the pillar
readings.support: saw the king standing by the pillar

readings.answer: the officers and trumpeters beside the king
readings.support: The officers and trumpeters were beside the king

readings.answer: all the people of the land rejoicing and blowing trumpets
readings.support: all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets

assessments.reason: Verse 11:14 states she “saw the king standing by the pillar,” which directly answers the question and matches the key.
The same verse adds that “The officers and trumpeters were beside the king” before “Then Athaliah tore her clothes,” so this is also something she saw beforehand.
The verse also says “all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets” before she tore her clothes, so this too is something she saw beforehand.

result.reason: The passage lists multiple things Athaliah saw before tearing her clothes, so more than one materially different answer fits the question.
